research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical publications and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Included blade-possession offences
verified_claims: The series includes possession of an article with a blade or point in a public place or on school premises.
limitations: The legal scope is narrower than all events involving a sharp object.

sources.name: Included offensive-weapon offences
verified_claims: The series includes possession of an offensive weapon without lawful authority or reasonable excuse in a public place or on school premises.
limitations: Private-location events may fall outside this statistical scope.

sources.name: Included threatening offences
verified_claims: The series includes threatening with a knife or offensive weapon in a public place or on school premises.
limitations: The threatening category was introduced later than the possession categories.

sources.name: Threatening-offence start date
verified_claims: The aggravated threatening offence was introduced on 3 December 2012.
limitations: Pre-2012 and later totals are not fully like-for-like for this category.

sources.name: Disposal counting unit
verified_claims: The statistics describe cautions and convictions or sentencing occasions for specified offences.
limitations: They are not police incident counts or victimisation estimates.

sources.name: Principal-offence rule
verified_claims: Where more than one offence is dealt with, published statistics can use a principal-offence framework.
limitations: Secondary offences may not appear as the counted offence.

sources.name: Offender-history source
verified_claims: Previous caution and conviction information is used to describe offender histories.
limitations: Recorded history does not capture unreported or unproven conduct.

sources.name: First knife-offence definition
verified_claims: First-time status refers to no previous caution or conviction for the specified knife or offensive-weapon offences.
limitations: It does not mean the person has no other criminal history.

sources.name: Age-group scope
verified_claims: The series distinguishes children aged 10 to 17 from adults.
limitations: Age at disposal must not be assumed to equal age at incident without record-level evidence.

sources.name: Sentence-outcome scope
verified_claims: The publication groups outcomes such as immediate custody, suspended sentence, community sentence and discharge.
limitations: Outcome categories should not be ranked without offence and offender context.

sources.name: Custodial-length scope
verified_claims: Sentence-length analysis applies to offences receiving immediate custody.
limitations: It should not be averaged across non-custodial outcomes.

sources.name: Repeat-offender legislation
verified_claims: The publication includes analysis under section 315 of the Sentencing Act 2020 for relevant repeat offences.
limitations: Statutory provisions and exceptions require legal context beyond a summary table.

sources.name: Court-administrative source
verified_claims: The figures are derived from criminal justice administrative data.
limitations: Administrative data can be revised as cases and records are corrected.

sources.name: Latest-period incompleteness
verified_claims: Cases in recent periods may still await final decisions.
limitations: Recent counts can change after later court outcomes are recorded.

sources.name: Other-disposal treatment
verified_claims: Cases awaiting final decisions are counted as other disposals rather than estimated in the latest methodology.
limitations: Other disposals must not be treated as final substantive outcomes.

sources.name: Pandemic comparability
verified_claims: Figures from 2020 onward were affected by pandemic restrictions and the court backlog.
limitations: Observed changes cannot be attributed solely to offence prevalence.

sources.name: Industrial-action comparability
verified_claims: Parts of 2022 were affected by Criminal Bar Association industrial action.
limitations: Quarterly throughput around the disruption is not directly comparable.

sources.name: Geographic breakdown boundary
verified_claims: The data tools can provide prosecuting police-force-area breakdowns.
limitations: Prosecuting force area does not identify the exact offence location or a parcel.

sources.name: Police-identified ethnicity field
verified_claims: The analytical tool includes police-identified ethnicity breakdowns.
limitations: Police-identified ethnicity is not necessarily self-defined ethnicity.

sources.name: Technical-guide revision boundary
verified_claims: The technical guide and latest publication should be used together for definitions and current methodology.
limitations: Definitions from older releases should not silently replace the latest guide.
